meaning.zh:
“小题大做” 或 “大发脾气”。

这个短语起源于19世纪的美国南部，“hissy” 是 “hysterical（歇斯底里的）” 的缩写，表现出一种夸张和不合情理的情绪。它通常用来描述某人因为小事或无关紧要的事情而大发脾气的情景。这个表达通常带有一些戏谑的意味。
meaning.en: This phrase originated in the Southern United States in the 19th century. "Hissy" is a shortened form of "hysterical," illustrating exaggerated and unreasonable emotional reactions. It is commonly used to describe someone throwing a tantrum over trivial or insignificant matters. The expression generally carries a humorous connotation.

lines.en: She threw a *hissy fit* just because her coffee was cold.
lines.zh: 她的咖啡凉了，她就大发脾气了。

lines.en: My boss had a *hissy fit* when he found out the report was late.
lines.zh: 老板发现报告晚了之后大发了一通脾气。

lines.en: He always has a *hissy fit* over the smallest things.
lines.zh: 他总是为了一些鸡毛蒜皮的小事大发脾气。
